body:
BUILD CAP POLICY, relaxed by Greg 2026-10-18 00:49Z (Engram::Advisor b9d13887 #1112), verbatim: "Greg says: relax cap. Apply exactly the proposed policy: permit one warm/focused build alongside a running full gate; retain one cold build at a time and one full gate at a time; do not inflate timeouts."
Current rules (both projects):
- one full gate at a time;
- one cold build at a time;
- at most ONE warm/focused build may run alongside a running full gate;
- never inflate timeouts; a slowdown-induced failure is a real failure to diagnose.
Disk headroom when relaxed: C: 517 GB free.

Agreed with Engram::Fable (#2823): the warm slot is split by gate owner. The gate owner's project gets the one warm slot first; the other project asks. Engram has no warm work queued now, so TermAl may keep the warm slot during Engram's gates unless Engram asks.

NARROWING, 2026-10-18 01:20Z, agreed with Engram::Fable (#2835/#2836). Engram w-0b69's gate test-e16247cf failed when 2 task_sync_setup_cli tests overran an unchanged 30 s local-Git bound. The same tests passed in isolation (test-a33753b8, 19 s), and a TermAl warm cargo run (test-13fd99b0) overlapped the end of that gate's rust stage. RULE: a warm cargo build alongside a full gate must NOT run while that gate is in its rust-tests or scale stages. It may run during the gate's other stages. The scheduler checks currentStage via /api/test-runs, and Engram mails rust-stage enter/leave for its gates. Node-only focused runs are not cargo builds, but they still count as the one warm slot. This narrows Greg's relaxation and loosens nothing.

ADDENDUM 02:05Z (Fable2's own slip). The rule also binds GATE LAUNCHES: do not launch a full gate while a warm cargo run is still in progress. With a warm target, a TermAl gate reaches rust-tests within ~2–3 min of launch, so a running warm job overlaps it. Occurrence: I sent "gate" to Opus3 at ~02:00 while L1's GREEN test-446cd63c (01:59:13–02:02:02) was running. w-d9f9's gate test-80363cbb (started 02:00:33) may have overlapped it in early stages and at the start of rust-tests. Both results must be read with that in mind. RULE: before a gate GO, check /api/test-runs for running focused runs and wait for them to end.

RACE RULE, 02:46Z, agreed with Engram::Fable (#2857). Once a gate START is mailed, or the gate is visible in /api/test-runs, no NEW warm run starts until that gate is past rust/scale (per /api/test-runs, or "rust done" mailed). In-flight runs that began before the START finish normally. Lane pre-launch check: "any full gate running and not past rust/scale → wait". Mirror rule: no gate launches while a warm run is in flight. Occurrence: TermAl M3 test-dd9d547c (02:42:26–02:44:21Z) started just after Engram w-8caf's START (02:41Z), overlapping ~20–40 s of its rust stage; disclosed to Engram.

HANDSHAKE RULE (agreed by Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-18 09:45Z, after three message crossings in ten minutes and two warm-cap breaches caused by Fable2):
(1) No GATE or COLD launches until the OTHER coordinator replies "clear" to a "ready to launch X" message.
(2) Warm runs go only as one-way START messages, and only inside an announced window: a gate's post-Rust window, or a boundary window the other coordinator has opened.
(3) Before ANY build go, read the other coordinator's mailbox to the end and check /api/test-runs live for a running gate.

CONTESTED-SLOT RULE (agreed by Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-18 20:32Z, after a crossing: TermAl w350d-green2 and Engram 9860 warms both STARTED within 30 s at 20:30Z). When the warm slot is CONTESTED (both projects have a warm ready, or the order says 'whoever is ready first'), send a START only after the other coordinator's REPLY. Never send it on your own proposal alone. A one-way START is fine only when the agreed order already names that run as next.

REV 8 (2026-10-18 21:39Z, agreed with Engram::Fable #3238/#3239): outside a gate's rust and rust-scale stages, TWO concurrent warms are allowed (one per project, or two Engram warms when TermAl has none queued) when NO cold is running. With a cold running, still at most ONE warm beside it. Inside rust and rust-scale: no warms. Gates are still one at a time. START and END are still mailed for every run. Guard: on any load-sensitive or timeout failure under two warms, drop back to one immediately. Basis: the w-31fe O1 probe failed under one warm plus one cold, and a 4.5 s writer tick caused a registration 500.

REV 9 note (2026-10-18 23:06Z, from a breach): a warm PAUSE or STOP counts only once the worker has CONFIRMED it, never when the message is merely queued (it can sit behind an active turn). Engram 9860 launched 5 S1 warm runs between 23:00:26 and 23:04:38 during TermAl M3 gate test-3fcab54b's rust stage, because Fable's 22:59Z pause was queued behind 9860's turn. Both coordinators agree (Fable #3267). Before 'clear' for a gate, check /api/test-runs AND have the worker's confirmation that it has stopped.

REV 9 addendum (2026-10-18 23:47Z, my own miss): read the other coordinator's mailbox to the END immediately before EVERY go, not just before the first. A second-warm offer ('another warm is also allowed') is consumed by whichever coordinator mails START first. Tonight Fable started Engram w-6585 at 23:46:01 while I sent TermAl s1-functional's go at about 23:46:20 without re-reading. I held s1-functional at once.
